settings.label: Homepage title (Google)
settings.default: NFC Google Review Stand & QR Menu Philippines | tapfour
settings.info: About 50–60 characters. Shown as the blue link in Google results.

settings.label: Default description (Google)
settings.default: Get more Google reviews with one tap. tapfour NFC stands open your Google review page and live QR menu, no app needed. From ₱899, shipped nationwide.
settings.info: About 140–160 characters. Used on the homepage and wherever a page has no description of its own.

settings.label: Share image (1200×630)
settings.info: Shown when tap4.ph is shared on Facebook, Messenger, Viber or X. Defaults to og-tapfour.jpg.

settings.label: Google Search Console code
settings.info: Paste only the content value of the google-site-verification meta tag from Search Console (HTML tag method).

settings.label: Sale ends
settings.info: Actual sale deadline in ISO format, e.g. 2026-11-30T23:59:00+08:00. Leave empty to hide the countdown.

settings.label: Stands left at sale price
settings.info: Set only to a verified current sale allocation. Zero hides the stock message. This is not synced to inventory.

settings.label: Order by email
settings.info: Set this to take orders by email instead of the Shopify cart (used by the static tap4.ph site). Leave empty on Shopify.

settings.label: Menu upload endpoint
settings.info: Where checkout uploads menu files (PDF/JPG/PNG), e.g. https://go.tap4.ph/upload/menu. Empty hides the upload box.
